coder_notes: All eight chunk files were read in full to their stated last lines. The season has six story arcs: Alexis (E1); the doula-fraud perpetrator (E2-E8: Karissa, Seanna, Amy W., Amy S., Audrey and doulas heard in clips); Gaby (E9); Chris Williams (E10); the Seattle tattoo-shop owner (E11-E12: Tyler, Danielle, Shane); a Los Angeles band leader (E13-E14: Jimmy, Anthony, Andrew, a group of women); Autumn (E15). The S18 preview episode only replays clips. Naming: perpetrators' names (including garbled transcriptions of them) are replaced with [perpetrator] in every quote; no other change was made to quotations. A few quotes run across a transcript line break; the bracketed timestamp marker at the break is omitted and the source gives the timestamp where the quote starts. All quotes were machine-checked against the transcripts. Judgement calls: (1) For the doula-fraud arc, the arrest/detention (no conviction by season end) is treated as protection for doulas whose harm had ended, since it removed the perpetrator's access to doulas; decisive work coded as TikTok virality because several survivors state the arrest followed within a week of the videos, though other victims' repeated police reports also contributed. (2) Karissa's and Emma's harm never reached an institution; the hospital visits Karissa accompanied concerned the perpetrator's own (likely false) claims. (3) Chris Williams (P21), Andrew (P31) and Anthony (P30) are borderline 'harm' inclusions and are flagged low confidence. (4) The 'Lucia Rising' group (P32) is a single record standing for an unknown number of women. (5) Tyler has four records for separate perpetrators. (6) Alexis's harm reached only a therapist with no response described. Unassigned: three data-point episodes on related themes were opened and read in full; none continue or discuss any season 18 story.
